control-character.json.reason: reference must not contain newline or control characters

duplicate-registry-repo-id.json.reason: registry repo IDs must be unique within a workspace

empty-designator.json.reason: reference with a hash must include a non-empty repo designator

empty-object-id.json.reason: reference must include a non-empty object id following the hash

non-hex-repo-id.json.reason: repo designator must contain only hexadecimal digits

over-limit-multibyte.json.reason: reference is 514 code points (1028 bytes), over the 513-code-point bound: the bound counts code points, not octets

over-limit-supplementary.json.reason: reference is 514 code points (1028 UTF-16 code units, 2056 bytes), over the bound: the bound counts code points, not UTF-16 code units and not octets

over-limit.json.reason: reference is 514 code points, over the 513-code-point bound; rejected, never truncated

short-repo-id.json.reason: repo designator must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters

two-hashes.json.reason: reference must contain at most one hash separator

uppercase-repo-id.json.reason: repo designator must be lowercase hexadecimal characters
